Here is the complete technical specification of the /photo-wish page for your Replit mobile app integration.

Photo Wish Page — Complete Technical Specification for Replit
Purpose
The Photo Wish feature lets users upload a personal photo, then uses AI (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image Preview) to overlay stylized wish text directly onto the image — creating a personalized greeting image. Users pay per generation from their wallet balance, with plan-based discounts.

Database Table: photo_wishes

{
  "id": "uuid (PK, auto-generated)",
  "user_id": "uuid (FK → profiles.id)",
  "original_image_url": "text (truncated base64 reference)",
  "edited_image_url": "text (base64 data URL of generated image)",
  "occasion": "text",
  "recipient_name": "text",
  "wish_message": "text",
  "sender_name": "text (nullable)",
  "text_style": "text (default: 'elegant')",
  "amount_charged": "numeric",
  "status": "text ('completed' | 'failed' | 'pending')",
  "completed_at": "timestamptz (nullable)",
  "created_at": "timestamptz (auto)"
}
Also reads from:

platform_settings — key photo_wish_price for dynamic pricing
profiles — wallet_balance for payment, plan for discount calculation
wallet_transactions — records deductions
API Endpoints
1. Fetch Pricing
GET /rest/v1/platform_settings?setting_key=eq.photo_wish_price&select=setting_value
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
apikey: <anon_key>
Response:


{ "setting_value": "99" }
2. Fetch History
GET /rest/v1/photo_wishes?user_id=eq.<profile_id>&order=created_at.desc&limit=20&select=*
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
apikey: <anon_key>
Response:


[
  {
    "id": "uuid",
    "original_image_url": "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQ...(truncated)",
    "edited_image_url": "data:image/png;base64,iVBOR...",
    "occasion": "Birthday",
    "recipient_name": "Priya",
    "wish_message": "Happy Birthday dear!",
    "sender_name": "Rahul",
    "text_style": "elegant",
    "amount_charged": 99,
    "status": "completed",
    "completed_at": "2026-03-25T10:30:00Z",
    "created_at": "2026-03-25T10:29:45Z"
  }
]
3. Generate Photo Wish (Edge Function)
POST /functions/v1/generate-photo-wish
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
apikey: <anon_key>
Content-Type: application/json
Request Payload:


{
  "originalImageBase64": "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRg...",
  "occasion": "Birthday",
  "recipientName": "Priya",
  "wishMessage": "Wishing you the happiest birthday! May all your dreams come true.",
  "senderName": "Rahul",
  "textStyle": "elegant"
}
textStyle options: "elegant" | "playful" | "modern" | "classic" | "festive"

Success Response (200):


{
  "success": true,
  "photoWishId": "uuid",
  "editedImageUrl": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...",
  "amountCharged": 99
}
Error Responses:


// 400 - Insufficient balance
{
  "error": "Insufficient wallet balance",
  "currentBalance": 50,
  "required": 99
}

// 400 - Missing fields
{ "error": "Missing required fields" }

// 400 - No profile
{ "error": "User profile not found. Please complete your profile first." }

// 429 - Rate limited
{ "error": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later." }

// 500 - AI failed
{ "error": "Failed to generate: AI content policy restriction" }
Data Flow

1. Page Load
   ├── Fetch platform_settings → photo_wish_price → set basePrice
   ├── Fetch user plan → calculate discount → discountedPrice
   └── Fetch photo_wishes (user_id = profile.id, limit 20) → history

2. Image Upload (client-side only)
   ├── User picks image file (max 10MB, image/* only)
   ├── Compress via Canvas API (max 1200px width, 80% JPEG quality)
   └── Store compressed base64 data URL in React state

3. Generate Photo Wish
   ├── Validate: image + occasion + recipientName + wishMessage
   ├── Check: walletBalance >= discountedPrice
   ├── POST /functions/v1/generate-photo-wish
   │   ├── Edge function verifies JWT → gets user
   │   ├── Fetches profile by user_id → checks wallet_balance
   │   ├── Calls Lovable AI Gateway (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image Preview)
   │   │   └── Sends image + text overlay prompt with style instructions
   │   ├── Extracts generated image from response.choices[0].message.images[0]
   │   ├── INSERT into photo_wishes (status: completed)
   │   ├── UPDATE profiles SET wallet_balance = balance - price
   │   ├── INSERT wallet_transactions (type: photo_wish, amount: -price)
   │   └── Returns { success, photoWishId, editedImageUrl, amountCharged }
   └── Frontend displays generated image in preview panel

4. Download
   └── Create <a> element with href=base64_data_url, trigger click
UI Components Used
Component	Library	Usage
AuthenticatedLayout	Custom	Page wrapper with sidebar/nav
Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription	shadcn/ui	Stats cards, form card, preview card, history cards
Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent	shadcn/ui	"Create" / "History" tabs
Button	shadcn/ui	Generate, download, add funds, clear image
Input	shadcn/ui	Recipient name, sender name
Textarea	shadcn/ui	Wish message
Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem	shadcn/ui	Occasion picker (15 options)
Label	shadcn/ui	Form field labels
Badge	shadcn/ui	Status badge on history items
PricingDisplay	Custom (discount-badge)	Shows base price, discount %, final price
Loader2, Upload, ImageIcon, Download, Sparkles, Wand2, History, X, Wallet, Send, Star	lucide-react	Icons throughout
toast	sonner	Success/error notifications

┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐

├─────────────────┬───────────────────────┤
│ CREATE TAB:     │                       │
│ ┌─────────────┐ │ ┌───────────────────┐ │
│ │ Upload Zone │ │ │ Preview Panel     │ │
│ │ Occasion    │ │ │                   │ │
│ │ Recipient   │ │ │ Generated image   │ │
│ │ Message     │ │ │ or placeholder    │ │
│ │ Sender      │ │ │                   │ │
│ │ Text Style  │ │ │ [Download]        │ │
│ │ Pricing     │ │ │                   │ │
│ │ [Generate]  │ │ └───────────────────┘ │
│ └─────────────┘ │                       │
├─────────────────┴───────────────────────┤
│ HISTORY TAB:                            │
│ Grid of cards (2-3 cols) with:          │
│ - Generated image thumbnail             │
│ - Status badge + date                   │
│ - Recipient name + occasion             │
│ - Download button                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
Mobile-Specific Notes for Replit
Image compression is critical — compress client-side to max 1200px width before sending. The base64 payload can be very large otherwise and will cause timeouts.
The generated image is returned as a base64 data URL — not a remote URL. Store/cache it locally on the device.
Text styles are processed server-side via AI prompt engineering — the client just sends the style ID string.
Wallet check happens both client-side (to disable button) and server-side (edge function validates before charging).
The edge function uses LOVABLE_API_KEY to call the AI gateway — this is a server-side secret, never exposed to the client.
Plan discounts are calculated client-side using the usePlanDiscount hook which reads profiles.plan and plans.photo_wish_discount from the database.
